Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules linked to document CHEMBL1123858. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, then inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (only include rows where canonical_smiles is present). Order by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
